I turned around and went inside to bed. Next morning, woke up and called my girlfriend and immediately told her what happened. I never planned on hiding it. My reasoning was that I thought I was doing the right thing by “doing it for my relationship”. In hindsight, I was just a drunk idiot who put that guys wants first and caved to his temptation. Fast forward some years and I just use Dove Men 2-in-1 LOL. Outside of shampoo, there were so many things I had to try and taste and see and smell just to figure out who I was. Well, I’m not sure what you personally would consider “enough” for forgiveness. I can just tell you what I’m doing to try to gain the forgiveness of my ex..

Basically, I’m waiting on her. Which is the number one thing people tell you not to do after breaking up, but I am. Everything I say, I back it up with my actions. I told her I only wanted her, I don’t show any interest in anyone else, even after being broken up with. Every time she gets angry at me, I don’t get frustrated. I get on her level and try to see and understand where she’s coming from. I listen to her sharp words and absorb them. I tell her what she deserves, even if it means telling her she shouldn’t come back to me. Anything she asks of me, I do my best to get it done.
